serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #Annalie.face.normal You: What’s up? Lady Annalie: Oh! It’s you! Lady Annalie: Wanna buy something this time, or did you only come to flirt with me again~? After having all those dark thoughts on my way here, it’s nice to speak with someone so energetic and cheerful. I can feel a small smile involuntarily appearing on my face, clearing up the fog in my mind. You: None of these options… {{wi}}I guess I might buy something later. #Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.surprised Lady Annalie: So why did you come here?! You do realize that I'm trying to have an honest business here, right? You: Come on now. I feel like we had this conversation already. It’s fine as long as no one is around. It’s not like I’m scaring any clients away. #Annalie.Eyes.closed+Annalie.Mouth.surprised Lady Annalie: I guess~ Lady Annalie: Just spit out whatever you came here for. I hope you won’t ask for some special favors. I would, of course, decline those… #Annalie.Eyes.pervy+Annalie.Mouth.smile Lady Annalie: …after a long consideration~ You: … After being teased so many times, my body feels nothing. It seems like I’m already immune to women…{{wi}} I hope there won’t be any long-lasting consequences of this… #Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.surprised You: Right. Lady Annalie: That weak reaction is kinda pissing me off, you know? Show some good manners and at least pretend to be flustered! Do you want to hurt a maiden’s delicate feelings? #Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.sad You: Is that maiden in the room with us? #Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.smile Lady Annalie: Since when do you know to riposte like that? And they say that old dogs can’t learn new tricks. #Annalie.face.normal Lady Annalie: For real, though, what do you want? You: Right. If you could move somewhere whenever you wanted, where would you go? Lady Annalie: Really? You come all the way here only to ask some hypothetical question like that? Give me a break! You: It might not be so hypothetical, though. #Annalie.face.shocked Lady Annalie: Huh? Did I hear that right? Are you really planning to move?
